wordlists.description: List of wordlist files to use (absolute paths or relative to working dir)

no_squash_sequences.description: If true, disables squashing of /../ and /./ sequences in URLs

cookie.description: HTTP Cookie header value to send

certificate_file.description: Path to client certificate file (PEM format)

extra_headers.description: List of extra HTTP headers to add (e.g. 'X-Forwarded-For: 127.0.0.1')

print_location_header.description: Print the Location header when redirect occurs

ignore_codes.description: List of HTTP status codes to ignore (e.g. [301, 302])

output_file.description: File to save scan results to

proxy.description: Proxy server address (optionally with :port, default port 1080)

no_trailing_slash.description: Do not append trailing slash to URLs

auth_credentials.description: HTTP Basic auth credentials as username:password

no_stop_warning.description: Do not stop scanning on warning messages

extensions_file.description: Path to file containing file extensions to append

extra_extensions.description: List of additional file extensions to append (e.g. ['.php', '.html'])
